Path: ② the capabilities an end user meets in the app — reading a record's roll-up fields | 缺项 | P3

## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p3` · `domain:ui` · `area:records` · `pm:blocked` behind objectui#11748. This is the closing card for the "one stored value, two faces" family, with an enumeration pin

Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectui#11748

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-07T00:54Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Triage: lands in `packages/fields/src/widgets/SummaryField.tsx` (`:25`, `toFixed(2)`) and the `summary` cell registration (`index.tsx`, to `FormulaCellRenderer`) ⇒ `domain:ui`; rationale: both faces are objectui renderers.

- **Why a closing card:** this is at least the fourth sighting of one mechanism: a read-only widget formats a stored number itself, while its cell goes through the number face. The earlier ones were objectui#11431 (number), objectui#11444 (percent and currency), objectui#11748 (formula, in flight) and now `summary`. The third occurrence of a family gets a closing card, so this card closes the family rather than adding a fifth single card.
- **The enumeration pin:**
  - `git grep -n "toFixed(" -- packages/fields/src/widgets` (tests excluded) gives 17 hits on objectui `main` at this write.
  - The PR classifies each one as a record-value read face, or not one. Input `step` / `onChange` normalisation, file sizes and geolocation coordinates are not.
  - Each record-value face goes through `formatNumberFieldValue` (the call every number face makes), so its widget and its cell read the same text.
  - Seen at triage, for the claimant to confirm: `SummaryField.tsx:25`, plus `GridField.tsx:496` (`${currency} ${n.toFixed(digits)}`) and `VectorField.tsx:20`.
- **Scope, otherwise as the card states it:**
  - `count` stays whole;
  - pins per aggregate × face × locale, with an equality leg;
  - `summary.mdx` and the `summaryOperations` doc comments in `@object-ui/types` move with the widget.
  - Currency display for summaries stays with objectui#10221.
- **Why blocked:** `summary` is registered to `FormulaCellRenderer`, which PR objectui#11751 (objectui#11748, open) rewrites. Claim after it lands, and build on its `returnType` and number rules.
- **Why p3:** the same class as objectui#11748. Wrong presentation, not wrong data.

This amends my grade `6028484725`: the enumeration pin's count is **16 hits**, not 17. That is `git grep -n "toFixed(" -- packages/fields/src/widgets` with tests excluded, on objectui `main`, re-counted by the command at this write. I had counted from a `toFixed` listing without the parenthesis. Scope and rule are unchanged.

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`.
